issue: pump_diagnostic_audit.audit() walked report['suites'] with .items(), so a receipt whose suites member was a list produced an AttributeError traceback instead of naming the malformed report. pump_strict_ordered_logs refused the same receipt with an unrelated pair/log coverage message.
finding: Both audits are the shared log oracles the differential scripts and the validator call on every retained receipt. A malformed or edited receipt reached the walker and failed with an exception that names neither the receipt nor the member.

change.diagnostic: audit() raises ValueError('report suites must be a mapping') before any Counter or walk work
change.strict: audit() calls require(isinstance(report['suites'], dict), 'Report suites must be a mapping') before walking
change.unchanged_behaviour: pair discovery, log comparison, coverage counts, mismatch payloads and exit statuses

runs.base_cli: python -B scripts/pump_diagnostic_audit.py --report <report with suites: []> --output <fresh> -> AttributeError: 'list' object has no attribute 'items' (traceback)
runs.fixed_cli: same command -> ValueError: report suites must be a mapping (exit 1, no output published)

cases: library refusal for list and string suites
a well-formed one-case receipt is still audited

limits: This changes which error names a malformed receipt. It adds no pair, no comparison and no case, and does not alter any valid receipt's audit or exit status.
